statement: Cloud host session snapshots expose only terminal shell identifiers plus presentation metadata. They omit Pi pane records, process IDs, PTY device names, local working directories, attachment paths and transcript paths; the layout is pruned to terminal panes.
consequence: Publishing local host paths or process/device identifiers would leak machine details and could expose the agent pane as a remotely controllable terminal.

enforcedAt.trigger: Axod publishes a session snapshot to the host relay
